'''Port Town''' was a region within [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] ventured into Port Town to visit the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Every Delight]].
